format: Markdown with embedded code snippets and documentation
description: Documentation for the FileChooser class and related methods in the Playwright library, detailing how to handle file upload dialogs across multiple programming languages (JavaScript, Java, Python, C#).

classes.name: FileChooser
classes.description: Represents a file selection dialog invoked during page interaction, allowing setting files programmatically, querying properties such as whether multiple files are accepted, and retrieving the associated page or element.

methods.name: FileChooser.element
methods.description: Returns the input element associated with this file chooser.

methods.name: FileChooser.isMultiple
methods.description: Indicates whether this file chooser accepts multiple files.

methods.name: FileChooser.page
methods.description: Returns the page instance that this file chooser belongs to.

methods.name: FileChooser.setFiles
methods.description: Sets the files to be uploaded through this file chooser. Accepts file paths, resolves relative paths, and can clear selected files if given an empty array.
